    def transcribe(
        self,
        options: TranscribeOptions = Body(TranscribeOptions()),
        user_session=Depends(verify_session_id),
        db: Session = Depends(Backend.instance().get_db)):
        # TODO validate options

        job_uuid = options.uuid
        if job_uuid is None:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Job not found")

        x_session_id = user_session.uuid

        session_job_ref, transcribe_job, file_upload = (
            db.query(SessionJobsDB, TranscribeJobDB, FileUploadDB)
            .outerjoin(TranscribeJobDB, SessionJobsDB.job_uuid == TranscribeJobDB.uuid)
            .outerjoin(FileUploadDB, SessionJobsDB.job_uuid == FileUploadDB.uuid)
            .filter(and_(SessionJobsDB.job_uuid == job_uuid, SessionJobsDB.session_uuid == x_session_id)).one_or_none())

        if transcribe_job:
            if transcribe_job.status in JOB_STATES_FINISHED:
                raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Job already finished")
            if transcribe_job.status in JOB_STATES_ACTIVE:
                raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Job already done")
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Job already enqueued")

        if not file_upload:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail="Uploaded file could\'t found")

        file_location = Path(file_upload.uri)
        if not (file_location.exists() or file_location.is_file()):
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="File not found (2)")

        job = TranscribeJob(
            uuid=job_uuid,
            uri=str(file_location),
            source=self.core.mq.name,
            filesize=os.path.getsize(file_location))
        db.expunge_all()

        future = self.core.executor.submit(self.enqueue_job, file_upload, session_job_ref, options)
        future.add_done_callback(partial(self.executor_done, job_uuid))

        # adapted fswatcher.enqueue_job (todo think about generic)
        # job = self.enqueue_job(db, file_upload, session_job_ref, options)

        # TODO enqueue job
        return job

    def download_file(
        self,
        uuid: str,
        format: str,
        user_session=Depends(verify_session_id),
        db: Session = Depends(Backend.instance().get_db)):

        job_id = uuid
        x_session_id = user_session.uuid
        upload_dir = self.upload_dir()
        transcribe_job = db.query(TranscribeJobDB).filter(TranscribeJobDB.uuid == job_id).one_or_none()
        if transcribe_job.status not in JOB_STATES_FINISHED or transcribe_job.result is None:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Job not done or missing results")

        filepath = Path(transcribe_job.uri)
        filename = filepath.name
        filestem = filepath.stem
        if not filepath.is_relative_to(upload_dir):
            # not uploaded
            filepath = upload_dir / x_session_id / job_id / f"{filename}"

        extension = get_extension_for_format(format)
        check_cached = filepath.parent / f"{format}__{filepath.stem}.{extension}"

        filename_new = f"{filepath.stem}.{extension}"
        # If already exists then deliver
        if check_cached.exists() and check_cached.is_file():
            return FileResponse(check_cached,
                                filename=filename_new,
                                media_type="application/octet-stream")

        temp_dir = Path(upload_dir) / x_session_id / job_id
        temp_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

        fullpath, result_filename = self.core.write_output(transcribe_job, temp_dir, format + "__" + filestem, format)

        if not os.path.exists(fullpath):
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="File not found")

        return FileResponse(fullpath,
                            filename=filename_new,
                            media_type="application/octet-stream")
